  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "The paper focuses on the Tuning Africa project, a regional curriculum harmonization initiative involving multiple African countries. It addresses harmonization across institutions and countries, focusing on regional frameworks and credit transfer systems. The paper explicitly mentions the Tuning Africa project, which aims to harmonize curricula across African higher education institutions to facilitate student and staff mobility and enhance the relevance of education to the labor market. The paper discusses the implementation of Tuning methodology in various African countries and regions, including the East African Community (EAC) and the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS).",
